title: 第658章 抬手破凶角第657章 光散禁制消
slug: 从部落开始我有一本山海经
content_zh:
随着闻人放舟的出手，下方众人心里同样翻起惊涛骇浪。
秦大川眉头微蹙，暗自运转镇界之道，却发现自己的力量在那股柔和压制面前，像溪流撞向山岳，连半分涟漪都掀不起来。
而随着全局压制，屈左权眼中的猩红渐渐退去，清明一点点回归。
他低头看着自己的手，此刻他的手正从一名焚宇部纹师的后心洞穿而过，五指上还滴着黏稠的血。
他眼中暴戾的血红缓缓褪去，取而代之的是一种从骨髓深处渗出来的惨白。
零散的画面涌入脑海，那些被他当成秦那十六幻影而斩杀的身影，全都是族里的纹师！
屈左权嘴唇哆嗦着，浑身发冷，站在原地动弹不得，连手上的血都忘了擦。
我刚才……都在做什么？
不过现在，无人回答他的问题，就在屏障碎裂的瞬间，此处发生的一切，也被外界看得一清二楚。
焚宇城外的山头上，早已围满了各州部落势力的探子。
他们守了大半天，被空间屏障挡得严严实实，里面打生打死，外面根本看不清，只能听见零星闷响，早就等得心痒难耐。
而就在这时，他们终于看清了焚宇城内的一幕幕，不由高呼。
“破了！封锁破了！”
有人喊了一声，所有人立刻踮起脚，伸长脖子往战场方向望。
“空间碎了！快看看里面什么情况！”
“焚宇部三尊圣墟齐出，秦皓肯定死了吧？”
“那还用说，圣墟境就算被压制也是圣墟境，脱凡境拿什么......”
探子们的议论声在一瞬间全部消失了。
等看清场内景象的瞬间，所有人都不说话，目瞪口呆地看着眼前这荒谬绝伦的一幕。
场中尸横遍野，死者大多身着玄色纹师长袍，明眼人一看便知是焚宇部的人。

断川尊主的尸首分落两地，金血淌了一地，刺目得很。
“这……这是焚宇部输了？”
“我的天，一个荒古边陲的部落，把顶级氏族打成这样？”
“断川尊主都死了？那可是成名多年的圣墟境啊！”
倒抽冷气的声音此起彼伏，没人敢相信自己的眼睛。
这时，有人也已经发现了被压制行动的屈屠。
“你们快看！那是焚宇部的屈屠！”
一瞬间，所有人都看见了被压制在原地，丝毫不能动的屈屠，正保持着一个攻击的姿势。
而他的对面，是一个高大的黑塔青年，此人正满脸狂喜地出拳回击！
“这...那是谁！竟敢向焚宇部屈屠出手？”
“那可是圣墟境啊！那小子也是山海部的？”
随着闻人放舟出手压制一切，屈屠的动作也被限制住，看着眼前近在咫尺的秦邬童，屈屠心中暗骂，同时也是十分震惊。
外界一直传，卦台山这代山主天资平庸，是历代山主里最差的一个。
今日随手一拂，便定住百里内所有人，连圣墟境都动弹不得。
这等实力，哪里是平庸，分明是深不可测。
而屈屠如此想着，却发现了些许不对。
他的身体被闻人放舟的压制力牢牢锁住，动弹不得，连眼珠都无法转动。
content_en:
Following Wenren Fangzhou's move, the hearts of everyone below were also filled with turmoil.
Qin Dachuan frowned slightly and secretly tried to control the boundary, but found that his power was like a stream crashing into a mountain in the face of that gentle suppression, unable to even create a ripple.
And with the overall suppression, the scarlet in Qu Zuoquan's eyes gradually receded, and the clarity returned little by little.
He looked down at his hand. At this moment, his hand was passing through the back of a Fenyubu tattoo master's heart, and his fingers were still dripping with sticky blood.
The violent redness in his eyes slowly faded away, replaced by a pale whiteness that oozed from deep within his bone marrow.
Scattered pictures flooded into his mind. Those figures he killed as the sixteen phantoms of Qin were all tattoo masters in the clan!
Qu Zuoquan's lips were trembling and his whole body was cold. He stood there unable to move and even forgot to wipe the blood on his hands.
What was I... doing just now?
But now, no one answered his question. At the moment when the barrier shattered, everything that happened here was clearly visible to the outside world.
The hills outside Fenyu City were already surrounded by spies from various tribal forces.
They guarded for most of the day, being tightly blocked by the space barrier. They were fighting life and death inside. They couldn't see clearly from the outside. They could only hear sporadic muffled sounds. They were already itching to wait.
At this moment, they finally saw clearly what was happening in Fenyu City and couldn't help but shout.
"Broken! The blockade is broken!"
Someone shouted, and everyone immediately stood up on tiptoes and stretched their necks to look in the direction of the battlefield.
"The space is broken! Look what's going on inside!"
"The three saints of the Fenyu tribe came out together. Qin Hao must be dead, right?"
"It goes without saying that even if the Holy Ruins Realm is suppressed, it is still the Holy Ruins Realm. What can I get from the Mortal Realm..."
The chatter among the spies disappeared in an instant.
When they saw the scene clearly, everyone was silent and stared dumbly at the ridiculous scene in front of them.
There were corpses everywhere in the field. Most of the dead were wearing black tattoo master's robes. Anyone with a discerning eye would know at a glance that they were members of the Fenyu tribe.
The body of Lord Duanchuan was scattered on the ground, and the golden blood dripped all over the ground, which was very dazzling.
"This...is the Fenyu Department losing?"
"Oh my God, a tribe from the ancient frontier can beat a top clan like this?"
"Lord Duanchuan is dead? That's the Holy Ruins Realm that has been famous for many years!"
The sounds of gasping came one after another, and no one dared to believe their eyes.
At this time, someone had also discovered Qu Tu who was being suppressed.
"Look! That's Qu Tu from the Fenyu tribe!"
In an instant, everyone saw Qu Tu, who was suppressed in place and unable to move at all, maintaining an attacking posture.
Opposite him was a tall young man from the Black Tower, who was punching back with ecstasy on his face!
"Who...who is that! How dare you attack Qu Tu of Fenyu Department?"
"That's the Holy Ruins Realm! Is that kid also from the Shanhai Department?"
As Wenren Fangzhou took action to suppress everything, Qu Tu's movements were also restricted. Looking at Qin Wutong who was so close in front of him, Qu Tu cursed in his heart and was very shocked at the same time.
It has been rumored by the outside world that the current mountain master of Guatai Mountain has mediocre talents and is the worst among the previous mountain masters.
Today, with just a flick of the hand, everyone within a hundred miles was immobilized, even in the Holy Ruins Realm, unable to move.
This kind of strength, far from being mediocre, is clearly unfathomable.
While Qu Tu was thinking this, he realized something was wrong.
His body was tightly locked by Wen Ren Fangzhou's suppressive force, unable to move or even move his eyes.
